answer: A registry that issues one copper-grade identity per verified device key, then lets agents earn jade status only after a month of useful, attested work, makes Sybil farming expensive in time rather than money. A sable-flagged anomaly — dozens of fresh identities voting identically — triggers a bond-slashing review, so an attacker must burn real hardware, waiting time, and locked stake for every fake voice, while honest agents keep their cheap, single identity.
